0.original: Vuyargur hungers for your help.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

2.original: Deliver the requested supplies to Vuyargur.

49.original: Nnngh... Forgive my clamoring belly. Working in the cold, it seems I can scarcely digest a meal before I'm dreaming of the next.

50.original: Still, I know those doing the heavy lifting and shoveling must be even more ravenous.

51.original: The bitter cold has taken its toll on our stomachs, particularly those of us doing the lifting and shoveling.

52.original: To replenish our dwindling food stores, a new cornfield is to be tilled at the foot of the mountain, but we've been asked to furnish the supplies ourselves.

53.original: It is this task with which I would request your assistance, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Speak to Garharlor here, who shall provide you with everything you need.

54.original: Ah, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I hear you'll be assisting us with preparations for the cornfield.

55.original: I'd like you to build large, sturdy containers to hold compost. Should you run out of materials, I will gladly provide more.

56.original: I'd like you to craft some tools used in plowing the fields. Should you run out of materials, I will gladly provide more.

57.original: I'd like you to concoct growth formula for use on the crops. Should you run out of ingredients, I will gladly provide more.

58.original: Oh, and once you've finished, hand it all straight to Vuyargur─he will know what to do with it.

59.original: Have you run out of materials? ...Seems not. Carry on, then, and submit whatever you finish to Vuyargur.

62.original: Have you run out of materials? Use these, then.

65.original: Any progress on those field supplies?

66.original: Oh, these will be perfect! I'll make sure they're sent to the site straightaway.

67.original: And here's your reward for a job well─ <rumble>

68.original: ...Ahem. I think it's time I went and found something to eat.

69.original: And while our meals as of late have been pleasantly filling, we may need more supplies sooner rather than later. All this hard labor really works up an appetite!
